title: A Walk in the Heart ♥️ A Podcast on Tantra, Psychology and Spirituality
author: Mahasiddha Yoga
description: A Walk In The Heart is a podcast on spirituality, tantra, yoga, meditation, psychology and self-growth. This podcast is for anyone who aspires to deepen their understanding of spiritual principles and to transform their lives using spiritual teachings. Expect deep dives, lively banter, and informative commentary on the theory and practice of Tantra yoga. We hope to be the place where spiritual seekers new and old come to be inspired, supported and uplifted as they navigate the path to enlightenment.
